subject: Taxes
title: Haiti's Revolutionary Tax Burden
description: A fast breakdown of Haiti's Revolutionary Tax Burden for builders.

hook.text: In 1804, Haiti won independence from France. Then France demanded 150 million francs in 'reparations'.

buildup.text: France threatened to reinvade unless Haiti compensated slave owners for lost 'property'—the enslaved people themselves.

discovery.text: Haiti paid this debt for 122 years, until 1947. The payments drained the nation's wealth across six generations.

twist.text: Economists estimate Haiti paid the equivalent of $21 billion in today's money.

climax.text: Haiti's story shows that unjust tax-like payments can impoverish a nation for centuries.

punchline.text: 122 years paying for freedom. The tax that broke a nation.

quiz.question: How long did Haiti pay reparations to France?
